items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Frank Federico played guitar. ... on the band was out there with Louis, was Louis Macenta on bass. ... Frank Federico played guitar.

ctx.x: Would you believe that? We don't belong to the union. But this is something that little Ray Vanitas. He could, he could remind you of things like that. This is one thing we used to talk about. Ray was a very dear friend of mine. And I sure hated to lose him. I hated to lose my other old boy. I think I have a bad luck with baseball is. Really? I lost three. Three. Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Pat Easterling, Ray and Frank. I didn't expect to lose Frank so soon. Ray rang up my wife, she used to talk to my wife and…
Wow. Oh. What about dance halls around Elysian Fields? Do you remember that?

items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Yeah, I was playing drums. Oh, and Charlie Hartman. Charlie Hartman was playing trombone. Yeah. Frank Federico.

ctx.x: So in this period, you were still playing drums, didn't it?
Yeah, I was playing drums. Oh, and Charlie Hartman. Charlie Hartman was playing trombone. Yeah. Frank Federico. Do you remember Polké Carrier?
Again, it's a name I've heard people say.
